items.title_en: Woman, 22, diagnosed with cancer after her ears didn’t pop on flight
items.title_zh: 22岁女子在飞机上耳朵没有弹出后被诊断出患有癌症
items.summary_en: A 22-year-old mum has spoken out about the 'horrifying' moment a doctor revealed the sinister reason behind an issue with her ears. Aida Burkins spent nine months searching for answers after a strange symptom first cropped up in May last year, marking the start of her health taking a nosedive. She subsequently discovered that she had a rare form of cancer that stunned doctors. Aida explained that it all started after she took a flight to Chicago , Illinois, from her home in Hemet, California, and was unable to pop…
items.summary_zh: 一位 22 岁的妈妈讲述了医生透露她耳朵问题背后的险恶原因的“可怕”时刻。去年 5 月，阿伊达·伯金斯 (Aida Burkins) 首次出现一种奇怪的症状，标志着她的健康状况开始急转直下，她花了九个月的时间寻找答案。她随后发现自己患有一种罕见的癌症，这让医生感到震惊。阿伊达解释说，这一切都是从她从家乡飞往伊利诺伊州芝加哥的航班开始的。
